feature_recipe.backbone: FullInformationPP info_euclidean, original constructor seed=seed+1000*fold, exact best.pt state_dict
feature_recipe.extraction: Frozen hooks sa1/global_net/fp1; interpolated F64, global G256, final L64. Exact original geometric route euclidean with geodesic interpolation from native_gd.
feature_recipe.fold_prior: For each ORIGINALfold24 FIT: count geometry.y over CT+MR; priors=counts/counts.sum(); maximum(priors,1e-8); normalize; use log(prior). This is legacy prior definition, not a new risk-probability clipping policy.
feature_recipe.normalized_design: C=concat(xyz,broadcast(G @ global_projection61)); normalize C/F/L by fixed per-model norms. Cross=(C @ context_product16)*(F @ fine_product16). X=concat(C64,F64,cross16), full/real144.
feature_recipe.FIT_model_aggregation: Each patient ONLY its ORIGINALfold two seeds. Average calibrated logits,F,L across those2 models. Never evaluate that patient using opposite-fold models in this reconstruction.
feature_recipe.later_external_deployment_model_aggregat: OriginalY deployment averages calibrated logits,F,L across all4 fold-seed models. No external inference authorized by this spec alone.
feature_recipe.point_candidate_labels: Argmax of averaged calibrated logits; not raw backbone argmax and not majority vote of per-model labels.

segments.selection: Only points whose predicted argmax matches this class

feature_recipe.within_class_segments: Elementwise maximum across all segment embeddings
feature_recipe.Pcom_left_right: Elementwise maximum between R-Pcom and L-Pcom embeddings
feature_recipe.CT_MR_patient_features: Elementwise MAXIMUM across CT/MR for each head; NOT mean despite legacy comments/protocol prose saying average.
feature_recipe.Pcom_supervised_target: Boolean OR of native label8or9 present in CT OR MR
feature_recipe.A2_supervised_target: Boolean OR of native label15 present in CT OR MR
feature_recipe.gate: Presence predict_proba for binaryclass1 >= locked0.05. Otherwise block Pcomindices7/8 orA2index12; relabel only originally blocked argmax points by remaining calibrated logits, no UNKNOWN output.

historical_limitations.GPU_policy: New runner must freeze TF32off, float32 feature operator order and CPU readout arithmetic or declared tolerance before actual extraction. Original extraction called numpy on CPU tensors; a GPU wrapper needs explicit cpu transfers and cannot assume original helper works on CUDA unchanged.
